Convention held throughout: inferred_network[i,j] = gene j's influence on gene i; in-degree = row count, out-degree = col count of the exact nonzero topology.

METHODS (independent families):
- Method 1, dynamic linear ODE regression (time-course): dX_i/dt = b_i + sum_j A_ij X_j, central finite differences, ridge per replicate, A averaged over 5 replicates. Direction+sign inherent. Proxy metrics: mean_r2 = 0.9158, cross-replicate stability = 0.4947.
- Method 2, steady-state linear SEM / regression-based DAG (16 steady states): standardized per-gene regression on all others; sign = sign(coef); each pair oriented by regression asymmetry (higher R2 = target). Perturbations treated as undocumented MULTI-target interventions (stated assumption, not confirmed). Proxy metrics: mean_r2 = 0.9860, mean |standardized coef| = 0.1161. Limitation reported plainly: only 16 samples for 25 nodes => underpowered, noisy coefficients.

COMBINATION: z-score each method's off-diagonal weights; combined = 0.6*z_ODE + 0.4*z_SEM so the time-course ODE method dominates on disagreement (as requested). Thresholded to top-120 |combined| off-diagonal entries => 20% density.
